topic: Facility data structure and filtering logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining the handling of facility data, specifically regarding city filters and master/facility relationships. Improvements suggested include adding an indicator for selected cities on a collapsed panel, showing the first selected facility and others in a popover.

[p1] raised concerns about simplifying the logic if a master facility and a facility could exist in different cities. Further data structure issues were noted regarding how `facility_master_num` and `facility_num` are handled across different time granularities (company/day vs. facility/hourly).

A technical issue was identified where, for most master facility categories and networks, the resulting array contained duplicate entries (appearing twice). This occurred because the data structure is concatenated to avoid additional queries for current categories.
decisions: Implement city filter indicator on collapsed panel showing selected facilities
